text: My video got disqualified by TikTok for harassment and bullying. And the unbelievable irony is which video got disqualified. Remember this guy? If I ask a dude, hey are you a feminist? And they want to start, well, define feminist, because like a radical extremist. Wrap it up, wrap it up, wrap it up, wrap it up. Well, here's the thing. Can you actually define feminist? Did she f****** stutter? Did I miss something? What was so difficult about her statement that needed further clarification? She's not looking for the dictionary definition, man. She needs to know if you're on board. You're not. She doesn't need to waste any more time on dudes like you. And since you need clarification, what I mean by that is, wet noodle, pick me ass b****** like yourself, who think masculinity is when make fun of women. Oh, and can you define feminist? You're a dork. You people are f****** dorks. Sit down for f****** sake. Yes, my response to this video got disqualified for harassment and bullying. Can you believe that? So GoodTrouble, the guy with millions of followers, showed less than three seconds of my video, called me a pick me ass b******, a wet noodle, and a dork, and completely misrepresented my point. I responded by explaining that the purpose of my video was quite the opposite of what he claimed. It was to educate people, especially men, about feminism, because I think it is important to understand its history, development, and what it actually stands for. And notice, I made a constructive response without a single insult. Yet, my video gets disqualified for harassment and bullying. What kind of upside down world are we living in? Now, unfortunately, TikTok simply says it detected this violation based on a report, but it doesn't specify who reported the video, so I can't know for sure who did it. But who would you suspect in my situation? That video did incredibly well. 3.5 million views on TikTok, close to 750k on Instagram, and even 18k on YouTube. And I haven't seen a response or an apology from GoodTrouble for his insult and his misrepresentation of me. Instead, several weeks later, I receive a disqualification for harassment and bullying. So let me be careful with my words here. GoodTrouble, I don't know for sure whether you reported my video, but if you did, that would be the most rotten thing I've encountered from another influencer, especially one with millions of followers. Even Arkwoman seemed to have more class. When she filed a copyright complaint against me for debunking her and using seven seconds of her video, she at least did not hide behind an anonymous report. So again, if that was you, GoodTrouble, insulting me directly in your video and then reporting me for harassment and bullying would be the new lowest point. Of course, I appealed the decision right away. But as usual with TikTok, nobody really checked it and it pretty much got automatically rejected. You can see that I submitted the appeal at 1.50 AM and a moment later at 1.51 AM, it was rejected. Surely I'm not going to leave it at that. I'm going to appeal it again and challenge it using dispute settlement mechanism under the Digital Services Act, similar to what I did with Arkwoman's copyright strike. And I won that case, by the way. Currently, the video is restricted in visibility and monetization, so you can only find it manually on my page. And now even my account check has turned orange, so potentially it might be at risk. I guess it's time to remind you that if anything happens to my TikTok, I also have a YouTube channel you can follow, Ilyas.Abdulian underscore YT. It has grown quite a bit over the past few months and is approaching 10,000 subscribers, so you can help me reach that number. I also have a backup TikTok account, although I haven't posted much there in a while. Maybe it's decided to start posting there again. Link is in the bio. In any case, whether it was good trouble or someone else who decided to report my video for harassment and bullying, this is our reminder that we shouldn't give up on fighting misinformation. I will continue pushing back with facts and evidence and I'm not backing down.
